headings.description: Clean, approachably modern without being strictly medical. Soft geometric sans that feels friendly.

body.description: Highly readable, reliable, clean text for medical data and advice.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Pastel & Soft
colors.description: Calming, trustworthy, and mood-improving. Replaces harsh medical sterile whites and panic-inducing reds with warm, nature-inspired tones.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers must have internal padding. Margin bottoms on sections should be at least mb-24.
layouts.grid_strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol with generous gaps (gap-8). Cards should be rectangular with max 8px border-radius.
layouts.navigation: Sticky nav with Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40). Always visible on desktop. No transparent backgrounds without blur.
layouts.hero: Split layout with organic 3D shapes or calm images, avoiding standard SaaS right-left format. Use asymmetric overlaps.
layouts.dashboard: Action-first layout. Single primary verdict area, supportive trends. Progressive disclosure for deep data.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (Tactile Variant) for small buttons. Flat Solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders (border-border/40) for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle noise overlays (grain) to kill digital flatness. Layered ambient shadows instead of harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.motion: Calm, slow transitions. Subtle loading animations (breathing/pulsing) instead of frantic spinners. Page reveals should feel like a deep breath.
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft, crisp edges. Nested radii. No thick, harsh borders.

components.upload_zone: Large drag-and-drop area. Dashed border with primary color tint. Soft hover state (bg-primary/5).
components.results_card: Instead of red for detection, use a neutral warm tone (like peach or warm gray) to present the result objectively without causing panic. Use clear, compassionate language.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Primary CTA uses solid primary color. Secondary CTAs use soft backgrounds with text-primary.
components.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts). Use soft palettes. Avoid harsh grid lines.

images.description: Soft orange abstract shapes, creates a warm, optimistic feeling for the landing or loading screens.
A smiling doctor talking to a patient. Builds trust and human connection for the Nearby Hospitals section.
Abstract blue waves. Represents technology, flow, and the AI model without being sterile or cold.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next.js (or React) frontend using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Install and use 'Outfit' (or similar soft geometric sans) from Google Fonts for headings.
Implement a calming Hero section with a split asymmetric layout, using the abstract orange shapes image. Avoid standard SaaS layout.
Create an intuitive drag-and-drop file upload component for the MRI scan. Include a text input for City/Pincode below the uploader.
The analysis loading state MUST NOT be a standard fast spinner. Use a 'breathing' animation or pulsing wave to keep the user calm while scanning.

Design the Results Dashboard carefully: Avoid giant RED text for positive tumor detection. Use a neutral or warm peach tone and compassionate copy (e.g., 'Information available. Let us look at the next steps together.').
Integrate an AI-generated Information section. Format the text beautifully with good line-height, using cards to break down complex medical terms.
Create a 'Nearby Hospitals & Doctors' section using a bento grid of cards. Include a mock map or location pins. Display the emergency number prominently but cleanly.
Add a 'Mindset & Next Steps' educational section that is uplifting. Use the smiling doctor image here.
Build an 'About PINN Model' section explaining the tech (PINN = Physics-Informed Neural Network) in simple, reassuring terms.
Include a 'Downloads' page for sample MRI data/reports using simple list items with download icons.
For the backend PINN model integration, leave a clear commented placeholder or a mock API call in the frontend code (e.g., `uploadMRI()` function calling `/api/predict`).
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-mri-button').
Ensure the app feels deeply empathetic, not like a cold generic data dashboard.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Do not use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s`.
Use 2x-3x more padding/margin than feels normal (p-8, p-12). Cramped medical apps cause anxiety.
No AI emojis in the UI (like 🤖🧠💡). Use proper Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on headers. Use `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md`.
Use sonner for toasts. Put toasts at bottom-center.
Use custom cursors or selection states for an elevated feel.
Add hover states to ALL interactive elements. Hover should slightly shift color or translateY(-1px).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Avoid low-contrast grays.
accessibility.structure: Use semantic HTML (header, main, section, article). Progressive disclosure for complex medical forms.
